hooks.name: Contract sync check
hooks.description: When exporter, TS types, worker protocol or profiles.yaml change, make sure both sides still match data-contracts.md and parity still passes.

action.prompt: A contract-adjacent file changed. Compare it with data-contracts.md (C1-C8). If the Python exporter, TypeScript types, worker protocol or profiles.yaml no longer match the contract, fix your change (do NOT edit data-contracts.md). Then run `make parity` and report the result.
